items.a: A Next.js 16 / React 19 boilerplate focused on SEO and AI, deployable on Netlify, with an isolated component library (Material UI) and OpenRouter wiring through a Route Handler.
The default model is a free OpenRouter model (openrouter/free). A daily quota limits browser calls; errors surface as toasts so you can retry easily.
No. Theme, cookie consent and the daily counter are stored locally (cookie + localStorage). The OpenRouter key stays server‑side and is never exposed to the browser.

items.q: How do I add a new AI action?
items.a: Drop a file in capabilities/agents/ (or a folder capabilities/skills/<id>/), then call POST /api/run with { prompt, agentId?, skillId?, inputs? }. The route stays thin: composition, quota, timeout and errors live in lib/ai (run → composeRun + runPrompt).

items.q: Is the site indexable by Google?
items.a: Yes: server rendering, localized URLs, metadata, hreflang, XML sitemap and an HTML sitemap are provided.

privacy.intro: Processing of personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: The data controller is {editorName}, a sole trader operating under the trade name {tradeName}, registered under SIREN number {siren} (APE code {apeCode} – Computer programming), listed in the national register of enterprises, with registered office at {address}.
Contact: {contactEmail}. For any question regarding data protection, you may use this e-mail address.

sections.heading: Data collected
body: This site deliberately collects no identifiable personal data server-side, except for any information you freely submit to obtain an AI response.
AI calls go through a Route Handler that relays a text request to OpenRouter; the API key stays server-side and is never exposed to the browser.
Theme preferences, cookie consent and the daily call counter are stored locally in your browser (cookie + localStorage) and are not transmitted to the server.

sections.heading: Purposes and lawful basis
body: The processing operations implemented serve: the functioning of the site (contract performance / legitimate interest), audience measurement and advertising (consent), and providing AI answers to your request (performance of the requested service).
If you include personal data in a message submitted to the AI, it is processed solely to generate the requested response.
The lawful basis of each processing operation is indicated above; consent-based processing can be stopped at any time.

sections.heading: Retention period
body: Locally stored data (theme, consent, counter) is kept as long as your browser retains it and until you delete it.
Host technical logs are kept for the period strictly necessary to operate and secure the service.

sections.heading: Recipients and transfers
body: Data is not sold or rented. Only the host (Netlify) and, where applicable, the AI provider (OpenRouter) may process the data strictly necessary to deliver the service.
If any transfer outside the European Union occurs, it is framed by appropriate safeguards (European Commission standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision).

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data, as well as the right to give instructions on the fate of your data after your death.
These rights can be exercised free of charge at {contactEmail}. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority (CNIL in France, https://www.cnil.fr).

sections.heading: Security
body: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
The OpenRouter key is stored in server environment variables and is never sent to the client nor included in responses.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: Description of the cookies and trackers placed, their purposes and how you can manage them, in line with ePrivacy and applicable data-protection law.

sections.heading: What is a cookie?
body: A cookie is a small text file stored on or read from your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when visiting a site. It is used to remember information about your browsing or your preferences.

sections.heading: Cookies used
body: Functional cookies (light/dark theme, consent): strictly necessary, they do not require prior consent and are stored locally.
Daily AI-call counter cookie: measures local usage of the quota, stored in your browser.
Audience-measurement and advertising cookies: placed only after your consent, they can be refused without degrading navigation.

sections.heading: Consent
body: On your first visit, a banner lets you accept, refuse or customize the placement of non-essential cookies.
Until you give your agreement, only strictly necessary cookies are placed. Your choice is remembered and can be changed at any time via the "Cookies" link in the footer.

sections.heading: Retention period
body: Consent cookies are kept for a maximum of six (6) months, in line with supervisory-authority recommendations, except for strictly necessary technical durations.
Audience-measurement cookies are kept for the minimum period necessary for their purpose.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can accept or refuse non-essential cookies at any time via the banner or the "Cookies" page.
You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies; some site features may then not work properly.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question regarding cookies, contact us at {contactEmail}. You may also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.
